about: Every place the mod reads or changes Ready or Not. kind=engine means stock Unreal Engine / UE4SS API (present in every UE game); kind=game means Ready or Not's own classes, whose names come from candidates tried in order at runtime and logged when one answers. verified=true only after it has been seen working in the running game (UE4SS.log line '[RoNUK] hook <id> ok via <name>').

candidates.desc: Names tried in order (functions, properties, class-name fragments, sockets or keys)

implemented.desc: Code exists for it in this build

verified.desc: Seen working in the running game
